content.answer: Fix rule: when updating a Bitable single-select field's options, never rebuild the option list from names alone — merge by stable option id: keep every existing option's original object/id untouched (pass it through), and assign fresh ids only to genuinely new names, numbering from max(existing id)+1; rebuilding by name alone silently breaks every existing row reference and clears all data values.
content.reuse_advice: For any catalog/enum update where stored records reference items by id, always do an id-based merge: preserve existing entries exactly as-is (same id), append only truly new entries with ids continuing from max(existing id)+1, and never regenerate ids from names — otherwise all existing references are silently invalidated.
